theta_proposals.status: DRAFT: relative criteria anchored to measured frame-0 baselines (absolute thresholds avoided where the author's init config already sits at a non-zero baseline); all values are proposals, not frozen acceptance criteria

theta_bonds.rationale: frame 0 of the AUTHOR's config already reads 0.054 against BOND_D_MAX=1.0 (property of the initial configuration, not damage); a doubling budget allows thermal fluctuation while catching catastrophic backbone failure
theta_bonds.risk: if the true dynamics drifts the bonded length distribution upward without structural failure, this flags false invalids; counter-check via pairs_v2 and displacement

theta_bonds.rationale: pilot fluctuation band is only ~0.002 wide (0.0539-0.0557 over 24k steps), so +0.02 is an order of magnitude of headroom
theta_bonds.risk: slightly tighter than B-REL-2X; the two proposals bracket a reasonable band for the Director

theta_disp.criterion: displacement_max(t) <= 20.0 oxDNA units (~17 nm, ~5% of the 402.56 box)
theta_disp.rationale: pilot max displacement over 24k steps was 6.25 units with no structural failure; 20 units is ~3x that band
theta_disp.risk: displacement grows with trajectory length; for 2e7 steps a purely displacement-based gate may misfire — combine with pairs/bonds gates

theta_disp.rationale: equivalent band derived from the pilot envelope instead of the box size
theta_disp.risk: anchored to a 24k-step pilot; extrapolation to 2e7 steps is an assumption, documented as such

theta_pairs.criterion: pairs_fraction_v2(t) >= 0.50 (v2 detector, mutual-nearest reference of 3300 pairs on frame 0)
theta_pairs.rationale: half of the reference base pairs intact separates 'hinge opened' from 'origami melted'; the v2 detector finally makes this fraction meaningful (v1 was based on 26-29 pairs)
theta_pairs.risk: the reference set is built on the author frame 0 whose local geometry may relax in the first steps; Director may prefer a quantile-based criterion after inspecting a 2e5 run

theta_pairs.rationale: stricter variant for a structure that should stay essentially intact on these timescales
theta_pairs.risk: may be too strict if the author's initial configuration is locally strained (long_bond baseline suggests some strain)
